text:
The corrupted element is most likely **Mq1**, the PMOS starving device in stage 1. Its width is 3.889 µm, while the matching devices Mq0 and Mq2 are both 25.92 µm, and Mq1 is the only one of the six starving/pull-up devices that differs from its peers. Its gate is biased by the same `pc` node, so its drive current is about 15% of the others at the same bias. That makes stage 1 pull-up much slower than stages 0 and 2 and caps the ring frequency, especially at high vctrl where the NMOS starvers are strong and the PMOS limit dominates. That explains f_hi falling short and the tuning ratio dropping to about 18 instead of 20. Mc1 and Mp1 are the next candidates, since they sit in the same stage and would produce a similar asymmetry if wrong.
